# `m.stocks.filings.insider_activity`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Open-market insider purchases and sales, summed per company and transaction day.

```python
m.stocks.filings.insider_activity(symbols=None, *, issuer_cik=None, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| Time range | `start` and `end` are sent as `transaction_date.gte` and `transaction_date.lte` |
| `poll()` | `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`: holds exactly the latest cycle's rows, keyed by `IssuerCik`, `TransactionDate` and `Symbol` |
| `sort` | any REST field of the rows (see Massive fields below), or several separated by commas, each with an optional `.asc` or `.desc` |
| `filters` | none |

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Insider Trading Activity (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The ticker the request named that the row lists in `Tickers`: a row that lists several of the named tickers appears once for each, so an article about AAPL and MSFT read for both is listed under each. A request that named one ticker gives it to every row. Null when the call named no ticker, and on a row that lists none of a request's named tickers. | REST |
| `IssuerCik` | String | SEC Central Index Key of the issuer company (10 digits, zero-padded). | REST |
| `IssuerName` | String | Name of the issuer company as reported in the filings. | REST |
| `LastFilingDate` | String | Filing date of the latest filing that reported one of these transactions (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). Transactions are usually filed within two business days. | REST |
| `NetShares` | double | Shares purchased minus shares sold. | REST |
| `NetValue` | double | Value purchased minus value sold in USD. | REST |
| `PlannedPurchaseValue` | double | Value of shares purchased under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan in USD. Zero on filings before the plan checkbox was introduced in 2023. | REST |
| `PlannedSaleValue` | double | Value of shares sold under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan in USD. Zero on filings before the plan checkbox was introduced in 2023. | REST |
| `PurchaseCount` | long | Number of open-market purchase transactions. | REST |
| `PurchaseShares` | double | Shares purchased. | REST |
| `PurchaseValue` | double | Value of shares purchased in USD. | REST |
| `PurchaserCount` | long | Number of distinct insiders who purchased. | REST |
| `SaleCount` | long | Number of open-market sale transactions. | REST |
| `SaleShares` | double | Shares sold. | REST |
| `SaleValue` | double | Value of shares sold in USD. | REST |
| `SellerCount` | long | Number of distinct insiders who sold. | REST |
| `Tickers` | String[] | Ticker symbols of the issuer as of the transaction date. Multiple symbols may indicate different share classes; the totals cover the issuer, not each ticker. | REST |
| `TransactionDate` | String | Date of the transactions (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
